connectors.description: The online shop: products and prices, carts, orders and order history. Use it to look up a product, see what is in a cart or where an order is, or add a product to a cart.

tools.name: find_product
tools.summary: Search the shop's products by words (name, brand, type).

tools.name: get_product
tools.summary: Get one product by SKU: price, unit, category, product page and image.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.summary: Get a cart with its lines.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.summary: Add a product to a cart.

tools.name: get_order
tools.summary: Get an order with its lines: status, delivery type, branch and totals.

tools.name: order_history
tools.summary: List the orders of a trade account, newest first.

connectors.description: Trade accounts and customer service cases, and whether the support team has reviewed an online order. Use it to find an account, see its cases, or open a case.

tools.name: find_account
tools.summary: Find trade accounts by name, contact or trade.

tools.name: get_account
tools.summary: Get one trade account with its cases.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.summary: List support cases, newest first, for an account or by status or priority.

tools.name: get_case
tools.summary: Get one support case.

tools.name: create_case
tools.summary: Open a new support case for an account.

tools.name: order_review_status
tools.summary: See whether the support team has reviewed an online order, for one order or for an account.

connectors.description: The business system: stock by branch, trade prices by tier, delivery status and account balances.

tools.name: stock_by_branch
tools.summary: Stock on hand for a product, branch by branch.

tools.name: trade_price
tools.summary: The retail price and the trade prices by tier (bronze, silver, gold) for a product.

tools.name: delivery_status
tools.summary: Where a delivery is.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.summary: The balance, credit limit and overdue amount of a trade account.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.summary: List branches, or find one by name.

connectors.description: The link between the online shop, the service system and the business system: whether an order has been passed on, and the log of those runs.

tools.name: order_sync_status
tools.summary: Whether an order has been passed on to the other systems, run by run, newest first.

tools.name: integration_run_log
tools.summary: The log of integration runs, newest first, by flow or status.

connectors.description: Product content: full descriptions, specifications and documents such as installation guides and datasheets.

tools.name: get_product_content
tools.summary: The description, features, keywords and pictures of a product.

tools.name: get_specifications
tools.summary: The specifications of a product (name, value, unit).

tools.name: get_documents
tools.summary: The documents kept with a product: guides, datasheets, warranty and supplier links.

tools.name: find_content
tools.summary: Find products by the words in their content.

connectors.description: The shop's search: what a search finds, suggestions as someone types, and what people search for most.

tools.name: search
tools.summary: Search the catalogue the way the shop's site search does.

tools.name: suggestions
tools.summary: Suggestions for what a shopper has started to type.

tools.name: popular_searches
tools.summary: The searches shoppers make most, with how many products each finds.

connectors.description: Messages sent to trade customers (email, text, in-app) and the templates they come from. Use it to see what a customer was sent, or to send a message.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.summary: Messages sent to an account (or all accounts), newest first.

tools.name: get_message
tools.summary: One message with its delivery status.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.summary: The message templates that can be sent.

tools.name: send_message
tools.summary: Queue a message to an account from a template.

connectors.description: Sales and service reports: weekly sales by branch, order status, review turnaround, service cases by topic, click and collect versus delivery, top products.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.summary: The reports that exist, with what each shows.

tools.name: get_report_figures
tools.summary: The figures of one report, period by period.

tools.name: report_totals
tools.summary: The total of a report's figures for each split (for example for each branch).

connectors.description: Website traffic by page and by day, the searches that bring people in, and conversions by channel.

tools.name: traffic_by_page
tools.summary: Views and visitors for pages of the website, busiest first.

tools.name: top_searches
tools.summary: The searches that bring people to the website from a search engine, with clicks and position.

tools.name: daily_traffic
tools.summary: Sessions, visitors and conversions day by day, newest first.

tools.name: conversion_summary
tools.summary: Sessions and conversions for each channel (search, direct, email, paid).

connectors.description: How people use the mobile app: sessions, screens, and where people drop out of a journey such as checkout.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.summary: App sessions, newest first, by outcome, app version or platform.

tools.name: get_session
tools.summary: One app session with the screens visited.

tools.name: screen_stats
tools.summary: How each app screen is used: views, time spent and how often people leave from it.

tools.name: drop_off
tools.summary: The steps of a funnel, with how many people reach each and how many drop out.

connectors.description: Addresses and distances: check an address, find the nearest branch, estimate the drive.

tools.name: find_address
tools.summary: Find addresses by words.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.summary: Check an address typed by a person: is it a real address, and if not, what is close.

tools.name: nearest_branch
tools.summary: The branches nearest to an address (by its id) or to a point (latitude and longitude), nearest first.

tools.name: drive_time
tools.summary: An estimate of the drive from an address or point to a branch: distance and minutes.
